Its unique shape is designed with midbattle flight in mind to facilitate aerial combat.|Inventory|TotK}} Kite Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 14 |durability = 16 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Kite Shield}} Kite Shields are mid-grade [[Shield]]s made by the [[Rito]]. Kite Shields bear a Rito emblem on its face, similar to the [[Paraglider]]. They are highly regarded among [[Rito]] warriors for their effectiveness and ease of use in aerial combat. These Shields belong to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created and used by the Rito.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} There are three locations where [[Link]] can obtain a Kite Shield. The first is in a metal [[Treasure Chest]] in the ground in an enemy giant skull at [[N. Tabantha Snowfield]] that Link must use [[Magnesis]] to pull out of the ground. The second Kite Shield can be found in a Treasure Chest in an ice formation at [[Hebra Headspring]]. A third Kite Shield can be found mounted on the wall in [[Selmie's Spot]]. Link can win it as a reward from [[Selmie]] by taking on her [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] Advanced Course and reaching the goal between 2:05 and 2:20.{{Cite|You clocked in at {{Color BotW|Red|[X]}}... That's not too far off my own record. That takes some serious skills! I'll admit, you've impressed me. Take this shield and use it the next time you hit the slopes.|Selmie|BotW}} Afterwards, it will disappear from its mount on her wall, and she will offer Link 20 [[Rupee]]s instead each subsequent time he meets that window of time.{{Cite|Whoops! This is the same shield I gave you last time, huh? Uh...how about some rupees as a consolation prize?|Selmie|BotW}} Due to their wooden construction, Kite Shields will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. Finally, they cannot be manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_042" |Life = 16 |GuardPower = 14 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 21 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Kite Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Kite Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Kite Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Feathered Edge]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *Kite Shields are one of the [[Permanently Missable Items]] in {{BotW}}. If both Kite Shields in the Treasure Chests are destroyed, and the Kite Shield won from Selmie is also destroyed, no more Kite Shields can be obtained. ==Nomenclature== The Kite Shield receives its name from its resemblance to a kite, as well as its aesthetic relationship to the Paraglider. Despite its name, it does not resemble an actual {{Wp|kite shield}}, instead more closely resembling an inverted {{Wp|heater shield}} with a concave chief. {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Paraglider * Rito Gear * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Rito Gear, Shields |items= BotW, AoC }}
